answer: The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in jade, expire in atlas, and fable lists each expiry. Anyone running 19 aliases as a result needs 72 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 557 identities would post 2498 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
